title: Configuration under halt redirection
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $b$ be a bit, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $t \in \mathbb{N}$. After $t$ steps, the redirected machine's state is the pair of the original machine's state and the last bit of its output if the original machine is still running; if it has halted, the redirected machine is halted exactly when that last bit equals $b$, and otherwise is in its loop state. At that time, the input head position, work-tape contents, and work-tape head positions agree with those of the original machine, while the redirected machine's output is empty.
